meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把网站部署到 Vercel,并管理 Vercel 上的项目、域名和环境变量;部署前先本地构建,部署后用 curl 确认线上链接能正常访问,再把结果给你。
howto.when: 当你要求把 web 应用部署、发布或上线到 Vercel,或需要管理 Vercel 上的项目、域名等资源时,它就会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先跑本地构建,成功后再上线

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录
say.note: 运行 vercel ls 查看部署列表

say.text: 从 Vercel 拉取环境变量到本地 .env

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys your web app to Vercel with the vercel CLI and manages Vercel projects, domains, and env vars. It builds locally first, checks the live URL responds, then reports the link to you.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web application to Vercel, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, env vars, and similar resources.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production for me
say_en.note: Runs the local build first, then deploys

say_en.text: Pull the env vars from Vercel into my local .env
